reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as selective recrystallization of the softer phase in a dual-phase lamellar structure is a known strategy to enhance strain partitioning and work hardening, though the predicted simultaneous jump to ~35% ductility and >2 GPa strength is optimistic without more specific alloy and processing details.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, using EBSD to confirm selective recrystallization and tensile testing to measure properties, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on simultaneous improvement.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful for researchers in this field, as it proposes a practical, non-compositional intervention to break the strength-ductility trade-off in eutectic HEAs, with a clear experimental path.
